skill.summary: Full-stack dApp generation skill for Jovay blockchain — from requirements gathering to contract deployment and frontend debugging

latestVersion.changelog:
Jovay DApp skill released as an end-to-end dApp generator for the Jovay blockchain.

- Guides users through requirements gathering before dApp generation
- Initializes projects with smart contract and Vue 3 frontend templates
- Supports ERC20, ERC721, and custom contract patterns via code generation
- Handles contract deployment, dependency installation, and frontend scaffolding
- Includes best-practice workflow instructions and testnet deployment support
